title: One Leftward Assembly-Rewind Step
statement: Let $S,V$ be finite deterministic machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a Boolean word, let $c$ be a configuration of $S$ on $x$, let $y$ be a Boolean word, and let $j$ be a natural number with $j<|y|$. For either Boolean choice bit $b$, one host step under $b$ from the assembly-rewind configuration with assembly head at cell $j$ is the assembly-rewind configuration with head at cell $j-1$, preserving the scheduler configuration and the assembled word $y$.
replaced: Let $S, V$ be deterministic machines, $d$ a scheduler configuration, $y$ an assembled word and $j < |y|$. For any choice bit, one host step from the assembly-rewind configuration with head at cell $j$ moves the head to cell $j - 1$, preserving $y$ and the scheduler bank.
